Bolest v podbřišku a třísle se u sportov: In athletes, pain in the lower abdomen and groin is classified by location as adductor-, iliopsoas-, inguinal- or pubic-related (Weir et al., 2015). In long-standing groin pain, an active strengthening programme that also included abdominal exercises led to a pain-free return to sport far more often than passive physiotherapy (Hölmich et al., 1999).
Když to nebolí, zvedněte nohy a pánev po: If it doesn't hurt, lift your legs and slowly raise the pelvis a few centimetres off the mat.
Lehněte si na záda, jednu nohu pokrčte a: Lie on your back, bend one leg and keep the other straight, hands under your lower back.
Lehněte si na záda, kolena pokrčte a cho: Lie on your back, bend your knees and put your feet on the floor.
Podsazení pánve a zvednutí pánve vleže: Pelvic tilt and supine pelvic lift
Podsaďte pánev, až se bedra dotknou podl: Tilt the pelvis until your lower back touches the mat and hold for 5 seconds.
Pokračování přes ostrou bolest v podbřiš: Carrying on through sharp pain in the lower abdomen.
Pomalu položte, po pěti výdržích vyměňte: Lower slowly; after five holds, switch legs.
Postupně rostoucí zátěž břišních svalů a: Gradually increasing load on the abdominal muscles and groin: holds, then movement, finally the plank.
Samostatná studie cvičení na úpon břišní: A dedicated study of exercise for the abdominal muscle insertion in runners is lacking; the choice of exercises and dosage are working assumptions.
